description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a filter implementation for logging chains that outputs only message content, filtering out metadata. It implements the LogNode interface and chains log messages to the next node, if any.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only message content, removing metadata for simplified log display.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message if the next LogNode exists, filtering out extra metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
